description: Turns the gates of a Sheliak shift register into eight summed pitch voltages, and goes immediately to the right of it

params.text: Scales what that register stage contributes to every sum here, from 0 to 1V, and starts at a twelfth of a volt so each stage adds a semitone

outputs.text: The first four main stages summed
The last four main stages summed, with a fifth of 7/12 of a volt added
The third to sixth main stages summed, with 2V added
The first four main stages summed, wrapped into one octave and dropped by 1V; it holds its last value unless one of the first two main stages is high
The eight main stages summed, plus the value of the lowest two triplet bits read as a number from 0 to 3, less 2V
The three triplet stages and the first four main stages summed; it holds its last value unless the first main stage and the first triplet stage are both high

notes: nothing comes out until a Sheliak is immediately to the left of this module, because Sheliak does all the arithmetic and writes into these jacks
every output changes only on a clock pulse arriving at Sheliak, so the module is silent while the clock is stopped
the lamp beside each jack shows a tenth of that output's voltage, so it brightens as the sum climbs
